name: 3/4 sit-up
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent. Curl the torso up toward the knees under control.

name: machine chest press
instructions: Press the handles forward until the arms are extended then return under control.

name: barbell bench press
instructions: Lower the bar to mid-chest and press back to lockout keeping the elbows at forty-five degrees.

name: dumbbell bench press
instructions: Press two dumbbells from chest level to full extension while keeping the scapula retracted.

name: dumbbell press
instructions: Press dumbbells from shoulder level to lockout controlling the eccentric.

name: incline dumbbell press
instructions: Press dumbbells on an incline bench to bias the upper chest.

name: pull-up
instructions: Hang from a bar and pull the chest toward it by driving the elbows down.

name: lat pulldown
instructions: Pull the bar to the upper chest while keeping the torso upright.

name: seated cable row
instructions: Row the handle to the abdomen keeping the spine neutral.

name: barbell row
instructions: Hinge to forty-five degrees and row the bar to the lower ribs.

name: incline barbell bench press
instructions: Press the bar from an inclined bench with controlled movement.

name: leg press
instructions: Press the platform through a comfortable range of motion.

name: chest supported machine row
instructions: Row the handles while the chest pad removes lower back fatigue.

name: dumbbell lateral raise
instructions: Raise the dumbbells to shoulder height with a slight elbow bend.

name: cable lateral raise
instructions: Raise the cable handle laterally to shoulder height.

name: face pull
instructions: Pull the rope toward the face spreading the hands apart.

name: seated dumbbell shoulder press
instructions: Press the dumbbells overhead from shoulder height without arching the lower back.

name: triceps pushdown
instructions: Extend the elbows fully against cable resistance keeping the upper arms pinned.

name: overhead triceps extension
instructions: Extend a dumbbell overhead by straightening the elbows.

name: barbell curl
instructions: Curl the bar without swinging the torso.

name: dumbbell hammer curl
instructions: Curl neutral-grip dumbbells while keeping the elbows pinned to the sides.

name: barbell squat
instructions: Squat to depth keeping the bar over the mid-foot.

name: leg press
instructions: Press the platform away without locking the knees.

name: hack squat
instructions: Descend under control on the hack squat sled and drive back up.

name: lying leg curl
instructions: Curl the pad toward the glutes keeping the hips down.

name: seated leg curl
instructions: Curl the pad down and under the seat keeping the hips pinned.

name: barbell hip thrust
instructions: Drive the bar upward by extending the hips at the top.

name: machine hip thrust
instructions: Extend the hips against the machine pad and squeeze at the top.

name: barbell romanian deadlift
instructions: Hinge at the hips lowering the bar along the legs with a neutral spine until the hamstrings stretch.

name: dumbbell romanian deadlift
instructions: Hinge at the hips lowering the dumbbells along the legs with a neutral spine until the hamstrings stretch.

name: machine seated good morning
instructions: Hinge forward from the hips against the machine pad keeping the spine neutral.

name: standing calf raise
instructions: Rise onto the toes then lower the heels under control.

name: seated calf raise
instructions: Press through the balls of the feet from a seated position.

name: cable crunch
instructions: Crunch the torso down against cable resistance.
